newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Roly in joint venture with Blockbuster.
newsitem.headline: Roly in joint venture with Blockbuster.

text.p: Roly International Holdings said on Tuesday it and Viacom Inc's Blockbuster Entertainment Group had signed a joint venture agreement for the development of Blockbuster stores throughout Asia.
The two would work together to identify, evaluate and recommend new opportunities for Blockbuster in the region, Roly said in a statement.
Blockbuster stores carry music, videos and movies.

In a separate arrangement to be concluded between the two parties, Roly would also provide merchandising, product development, sourcing and retail distribution consultancy services to Blockbuster, the Roly statement said.
Roly intends to began merchandising services in Taiwan, and expand to other countries in the region.
"Eventually, Roly International hopes to design, develop and supply merchandise to all 5,000 Blockbuster stores worldwide," Roly chairman Robert Wang said in the statement.
Roly said the joint venture was not expected to have an impact on its earnings for the 1997 financial year. It gave no other financial details.
Roly is an international distributor of home decor and consumer products. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
